final_action.public_message: Gemini, bigger but contained: Boardwalk + Atlantic for Mediterranean, no cash. You get the Park Place lottery plus another yellow blocker; I only get the cheap browns, not a mid-board killer set.
final_action.private_thought: Best legal comeback: complete browns, then unmortgage Baltic and use the 8 houses to create income/house lock. Overpaying Boardwalk+Atlantic is fine because neither makes me money now and it doesn’t give Gemini a monopoly.
